H6900.def: or qburah {keb-oo-raw'}; feminine passive participle of «06912»; sepulture; (concretely) a sepulchre:--burial, burying place, grave, sepulchre.

H6901.def: a primitive root; to admit, i.e. take (literally or figuratively):--choose, (take) hold, receive, (under-)take.

H6903.def: (Aramaic) or qobel (Aramaic) {kob-ale'}; (corresponding to «06905»; (adverbially) in front of; usually (with other particles) on account of, so as, since, hence:--+ according to, + as, + because, before, + for this cause, + forasmuch as, + by this means, over against, by reason of, + that, + therefore, + though, + wherefore.

H6904.et: from (06901) in the sense of confronting (as standing opposite in order to receive)
H6904.def: from «06901» in the sense of confronting (as standing opposite in order to receive); a battering-ram:--war.

H6905.et: from (06901) in the sense of opposite [see (06904)]
H6905.def: from «06901» in the sense of opposite (see «06904»); the presence, i.e. (adverbially) in front of:--before.

H6906.def: a primitive root; to cover, i.e. (figuratively) defraud:--rob, spoil.

H6907.def: from «06906»; a goblet (as deep like a cover):--dregs.

H6908.def: a primitive root; to grasp, i.e. collect:--assemble (selves), gather (bring) (together, selves together, up), heap, resort, × surely, take up.

H6909.def: from «06908» and «0410»; God has gathered; Kabtseel, a place in Palestine:--Kabzeel. Compare «03343».

H6910.def: feminine passive participle of «06908»; a hoard:--X gather.

H6911.def: dual from «06908»; a double heap; Kibtsajim, a place in Palestine:--Kibzaim.

H6912.def: a primitive root; to inter:--X in any wise, bury(-ier).

H6913.def: or (feminine) qibrah {kib-raw'}; from «06912»; a sepulchre:--burying place, grave, sepulchre.

H6914.et: from the fem. pl. of (06913) and (08378) with the article interposed
H6914.def: from the feminine plural of «06913» and «08378» with the article interposed; graves of the longing; Kibroth-hat-Taavh, a place in the Desert:--Kibroth-hattaavah.

H6915.def: a primitive root; to shrivel up, i.e. contract or bend the body (or neck) in deference:--bow (down) (the) head, stoop.

H6916.def: from «06915»; cassia bark (as in shrivelled rolls):--cassia.

H6917.def: passive participle of «06923»; a pristine hero:--ancient.

H6918.def: or qadosh {kaw-doshe'}; from «06942»; sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary:--holy (One), saint.

H6919.def: a primitive root to inflame:--burn, kindle.

H6920.def: from «06919»; inflammation, i.e. febrile disease:--burning ague, fever.

H6921.def: or qadim {kaw-deem'}; from «06923»; the fore or front part; hence (by orientation) the East (often adverbially, eastward, for brevity the east wind):--east(-ward, wind).

H6923.def: a primitive root; to project (one self), i.e. precede; hence, to anticipate, hasten, meet (usually for help):--come (go, (flee)) before, + disappoint, meet, prevent.

H6924.def: or qedmah {kayd'-maw}; from «06923»; the front, of place (absolutely, the fore part, relatively the East) or time (antiquity); often used adverbially (before, anciently, eastward):--aforetime, ancient (time), before, east (end, part, side, -ward), eternal, × ever(-lasting), forward, old, past. Compare «06926».

H6925.def: (Aramaic) or qdam (Aramaic) (Daniel 7:l3) {ked-awm'}; corresponding to «06924»; before:--before, × from, × I (thought), × me, + of, × it pleased, presence.

H6926.def: feminine of «06924»; the forward part (or relatively) East (often adverbially, on the east or in front):--east(-ward).

H6927.def: from «06923»; priority (in time); also used adverbially (before):--afore, antiquity, former (old) estate.

H6928.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «06927»; former time:-- afore(-time), ago.

H6929.def: from «06923»; precedence; Kedemah, a son of Ishmael:--Kedemah.

H6931.def: or qadmoniy {kad-mo-nee'}; from «06930»; (of time) anterior or (of place) oriental:--ancient, they that went before, east, (thing of) old.

H6932.def: from «06923»; beginnings; Kedemoth, a place in eastern Palestine:--Kedemoth.

H6933.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «06923»; first:--first.

H6934.def: from «06924» and «0410»; presence of God; Kadmiel, the name of three Israelites:--Kadmiel.

H6935.def: the same as «06931»; ancient, i.e. aboriginal; Kadmonite (collectively), the name of a tribe in Palestine:-- Kadmonites.

H6936.def: from «06915»; the crown of the head (as the part most bowed):--crown (of the head), pate, scalp, top of the head.

H6937.def: a primitive root; to be ashy, i.e. dark-colored; by implication, to mourn (in sackcloth or sordid garments):--be black(-ish), be (make) dark(-en), × heavily, (cause to) mourn.

H6938.def: from «06937»; dusky (of the skin or the tent); Kedar, a son of Ishmael; also (collectively) Bedouin (as his descendants or representatives):--Kedar.

H6939.def: from «06937»; dusky place; Kidron, a brook near Jerusalem:--Kidron.

H6941.def: adverb from «06937»; blackish ones (i.e. in sackcloth); used adverbially, in mourning weeds:--mournfully.

H6942.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make, pronounce or observe as) clean (ceremonially or morally):--appoint, bid, consecrate, dedicate, defile, hallow, (be, keep) holy(-er, place), keep, prepare, proclaim, purify, sanctify(-ied one, self), × wholly.

H6943.def: from «06942»; a sanctum; Kedesh, the name of four places in Palestine:--Kedesh.

H6944.def: from «06942»; a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity:--consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, (X most) holy (X day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.

H6945.def: from «06942»; a (quasi) sacred person, i.e. (technically) a (male) devotee (by prostitution) to licentious idolatry:-- sodomite, unclean.

H6946.def: the same as «06945»; sanctuary; Kadesh, a place in the Desert:--Kadesh. Compare «06947».

H6947.et: from the same as (06946) and an otherwise unused word (apparently compounded of a correspondent to (01251) and a derivative of (05128)) meaning desert of a fugitive
H6947.def: from the same as «06946» and an otherwise unused word (apparently compounded of a correspondent to «01251» and a derivative of «05128») meaning desert of a fugitive; Kadesh of (the) Wilderness of Wandering; Kadesh-Barnea, a place in the Desert:--Kadesh-barnea.

H6948.def: feminine of «06945»; a female devotee (i.e. prostitute):--harlot, whore.

H6949.def: a primitive root; to be dull:--be set on edge, be blunt.

H6950.def: a primitive root; to convoke:--assemble (selves) (together), gather (selves) (together).

H6951.def: from «06950»; assemblage (usually concretely):--assembly, company, congregation, multitude.

H6953.def: feminine of active participle from «06950»; a (female) assembler (i.e. lecturer): abstractly, preaching (used as a "nom de plume", Koheleth):--preacher.

H6954.def: from «06950»; convocation; Kehelathah, a place in the Desert:--Kehelathah.

H6955.et: from an unused root meaning to ally oneself
H6955.def: from an unused root meaning to ally oneself; allied; Kehath, an Israelite:--Kohath.

H6956.def: patronymically from «06955»; a Kohathite (collectively) or descendants of Kehath:--Kohathites.

H6957.def: or qav {kawv}; from «06960» (compare «06961»); a cord (as connecting), especially for measuring; figuratively, a rule; also a rim, a musical string or accord:--line. Compare «06978».

H6958.def: or qayah (Jer. 25:27) {kaw-yaw'}; a primitive root; to vomit:--spue (out), vomit (out, up, up again).

H6959.def: a form collateral to «03553»; a helmet:--helmet.

H6960.def: a primitive root; to bind together (perhaps by twisting), i.e. collect; (figuratively) to expect:--gather (together), look, patiently, tarry, wait (for, on, upon).

H6961.def: from «06960»; a (measuring) cord (as if for binding):--line.

H6962.def: a primitive root; properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) detest:--begrieved, loathe self.

H6963.et: from an unused root meaning to call aloud
H6963.def: or qol {kole}; from an unused root meaning to call aloud; a voice or sound:--+ aloud, bleating, crackling, cry (+ out), fame, lightness, lowing, noise, + hold peace, (pro-)claim, proclamation, + sing, sound, + spark, thunder(-ing), voice, + yell.

H6964.def: from «06963» and «03050»; voice of Jah; Kolajah, the name of two Israelites:--Kolaiah.

H6965.def: a primitive root; to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative):--abide, accomplish, × be clearer, confirm, continue, decree, × be dim, endure, × enemy, enjoin, get up, make good, help, hold, (help to) lift up (again), make, × but newly, ordain, perform, pitch, raise (up), rear (up), remain, (a-)rise (up) (again, against), rouse up, set (up), (e-)stablish, (make to) stand (up), stir up, strengthen, succeed, (as-, make) sure(-ly), (be) up(-hold, - rising).

H6966.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «06965»:--appoint, establish, make, raise up self, (a-)rise (up), (make to) stand, set (up).

H6967.def: from «06965»; height:--X along, height, high, stature, tall.

H6969.def: a primitive root; to strike a musical note, i.e. chant or wail (at a funeral):--lament, mourning woman.

H6970.et: probably from (06972) in the original sense of cutting off
H6970.def: probably from «06972» in the original sense of cutting off; curtailment; Koa, a region of Bab.:--Koa.

H6971.def: or qoph {kofe}; probably of foreign origin; a monkey:--ape.

H6972.def: a primitive root; to clip off; used only as denominative from «07019»; to spend the harvest season:--summer.

H6973.et: a primitive root [identical with (06972) through the idea of severing oneself from (compare (06962))]
H6973.def: a primitive root (identical with «06972» through the idea of severing oneself from (compare «06962»)); to be (causatively, make) disgusted or anxious:--abhor, be distressed, be grieved, loathe, vex, be weary.

H6974.et: a primitive root [identical with (06972) through the idea of abruptness in starting up from sleep (compare (03364))]
H6974.def: a primitive root (identical with «06972» through the idea of abruptness in starting up from sleep (compare «03364»)); to awake (literally or figuratively):--arise, (be) (a-)wake, watch.

H6975.def: or qots {kotse}; from «06972» (in the sense of pricking); a thorn:--thorn.

H6976.def: the same as «06975»; Kots, the name of two Israelites:--Koz, Hakkoz (including the article).

H6977.et: pass part of (06972) in its original sense
H6977.def: feminine passive participle of «06972» in its original sense; a forelock (as shorn):--lock.

H6978.et: from (06957) (in the sense of a fastening)
H6978.def: from «06957» (in the sense of a fastening); stalwart:--X meted out.

H6979.def: a primitive root; to trench; by implication, to throw forth; also (denominative from «07023») to wall up, whether literal (to build a wall) or figurative (to estop):--break down, cast out, destroy, dig.

H6980.def: from «06979»; (only plural) trenches, i.e. a web (as if so formed):--web.

H6981.def: or «0Qore7» (1 Chronicles 26:1) {ko-ray'}; active participle of «07121»; crier; Kore, the name of two Israelites:--Kore.

H6982.def: or qorah {ko-raw'}; from «06979»; a rafter (forming trenches as it were); by implication, a roof:--beam, roof.

H6983.def: a primitive root; to bend; used only as denominative for «03369», to set a trap:--lay a snare.

H6984.et: from the pass part of (06983) and (03050)
H6984.def: from the passive participle of «06983» and «03050»; entrapped of Jah; Kushajah, an Israelite:--Kushaiah.

H6985.et: from (06990) in the sense of abbreviation
H6985.def: from «06990» in the sense of abbreviation; a little, i.e. (adverbially) merely:--very.

H6986.et: from an unused root meaning to cut off
H6986.def: from an unused root meaning to cut off; ruin:--destroying, destruction.

H6989.def: feminine passive participle of «06999»; perfumed; Keturah, a wife of Abraham:--Keturah.

H6990.def: a primitive root; to clip off, i.e. (figuratively) destroy:--be cut off.

H6991.def: a primitive root; properly, to cut off, i.e. (figuratively) put to death:--kill, slay.

H6994.def: a primitive root (rather denominative from «06996»); to diminish, i.e. be (causatively, make) diminutive or (figuratively) of no account:--be a (make) small (thing), be not worthy.

H6995.def: from «06994»; a pettiness, i.e. the little finger:--little finger.

H6996.def: or qaton {kaw-tone'}; from «06962»; abbreviated, i.e. diminutive, literally (in quantity, size or number) or figuratively (in age or importance):--least, less(-er), little (one), small(-est, one, quantity, thing), young(-er, -est).

H6997.def: the same as «06996»; small; Katan, an Israelite:--Hakkatan (including the article).

H6998.def: a primitive root; to strip off:--crop off, cut down (up), pluck.

H6999.et: a primitive root [identical with (07000) through the idea of fumigation in a close place and perhaps thus driving out the occupants]
H6999.def: a primitive root (identical with «07000» through the idea of fumigation in a close place and perhaps thus driving out the occupants); to smoke, i.e. turn into fragrance by fire (especially as an act of worship):--burn (incense, sacrifice) (upon), (altar for) incense, kindle, offer (incense, a sacrifice).
